verdict.rationale: Grounding a voice agent on your own documents is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions a knowledge base, document upload or RAG feature. Related items (ready-to-use tools, custom OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints, prompts) are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
